articles.title: AI R&D-relevant model capabilities are improving rapidly and are getting harder to measure

draft.overview: 读懂五成成功率下的任务长度，以及这条曲线很难衡量哪些研究工作。
draft.reason: METR 用专家完成同一道题所需的工时衡量任务长度，发现 Agent 有五成把握做完的任务，约每 3.6 个月翻一倍。换成需要自己判断研究方向的工作，单看这条曲线，很难估计 Agent 究竟能接手多少。

blocks.body:
研究者先估算专家要花多少工时才能达到指定成绩，再看每一代模型在多长的任务上仍有一半机会达到同一成绩。
合并新旧两套测试，翻倍时间估计为 3.61 个月，95% 置信区间为 2.08 至 4.94 个月。这里的“小时”指专家工时。模型本身可能跑得快得多。
blocks.evidence: time horizons are doubling roughly every 3.61 months

blocks.body:
METR 请模型设计短时间内难以判断好坏的评测题，模型仍倾向于出能自动算分的优化题。交上来的题，没有一道被 METR 用进这份报告。
优化代码可以马上计时，判断研究方向是否有价值可能要等很久。读增长曲线时，人类工时本身也有不确定性。这份报告里只有约 9% 的工时估计直接用了人员实测。
blocks.evidence: None of the tasks agents produced were sufficiently useful

localization.reason_en: On METR’s R&D tests, the length of tasks agents could complete half the time doubled roughly every 3.6 months, measured in expert work hours. That curve tells us less about work where the agent has to judge for itself which research direction is worth pursuing.
localization.summary_en: METR measures task length by the time a skilled person would take to reach the same score. For each model it estimates the length at which success falls to 50%. Across two task suites, this horizon doubled every 3.61 months, with a 95% confidence interval of 2.08–4.94 months. An agent may take far less wall-clock time.
localization.thinking_en:
Asked to design tests for decisions with poor short-term feedback, the agents still tended to propose automatically scored optimization tasks. METR used none of their submissions in this report.
Timing a piece of code gives immediate feedback. Recognizing a worthwhile research question can take much longer. The hours scale is uncertain too: only about 9% of the human-time estimates directly used human baselines.

localization.image_caption_en: Model release dates run along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis measures human work time. The histogram shows the bootstrapped doubling-time estimates. Source: METR, CC BY.
localization.image_alt_en: The fitted horizon rises with model release date. The doubling-time distribution centers near 3.6 months.

articles.title: Don’t Just Trust Your Memory: Evidence-Linked Memory Reduces Memory-Induced Degradation in LLM Agents

draft.overview: 用相同经验做对照，检验回看操作记录能否减少旧经验带来的错误。
draft.reason: 给 Agent 同一份经验笔记，让它回查当时做过什么，它就更少把原本会做的题做错。五套基准共八组测试中，拿到原始记录和回查提示的 Agent，平均比只看笔记多得 3.2 分。

blocks.body:
一条旧笔记说，把物品放在亮灯旁就算完成任务。轮到检查花瓶，Agent 只开灯就交差。它本来知道要先拿起花瓶。
WikiTrace 给每条经验连上产生它的原始操作和对这次成败的解释。作者比较了拿到相同经验的两组，既看新做对多少题，也查原来会做的题又错了多少。
blocks.evidence: Picks up the vase, then turns on the lamp

blocks.body:
如果只报总分，新增的正确答案可能盖住被坏经验教错的旧题。测试记忆功能时，可以留一组助手原先稳定做对的任务，专门数它学坏了多少。
这次实验中，带回查的系统每题平均推理成本比只给经验高 17%。如果笔记多到无法一次全部给模型，每道题该找出哪些笔记，还有待验证。
blocks.evidence: 1.17 times as much per task as Insights Only

localization.reason_en: Agents lost fewer previously solved tasks when they could check their notes against the actions that produced them. Across eight suites from five benchmarks, agents with source records and a prompt to check them averaged 3.2 points more than agents given the same notes alone.
localization.summary_en:
One note said placing an object beside a lit lamp completed the task. Asked to examine a vase, the agent switched on the lamp and stopped. Without the note, it picked up the vase first.
WikiTrace links each lesson to the original actions and an explanation of what happened. The study tracked newly solved tasks as well as previously solved tasks that now failed.
localization.thinking_en:
An aggregate score can hide familiar tasks lost to bad advice. When testing memory, keep cases the agent already solves reliably and count the ones it now fails.
Evidence checking also has a cost: test-time spending per task averaged 17% more than with notes alone. Finding the right lesson in a much larger archive remains an open question.
localization.image_title_en: Original figure 1 · When a lesson leads an agent astray
localization.image_caption_en: The top panel distinguishes wrong, out-of-scope and misused memories. The lower panel follows a suspect lesson back to the source run and shows it being revised. Figure by Yukyeong Lee et al. (CC BY 4.0).
localization.image_alt_en: A diagram contrasts failing after reusing a bad lesson with revising it after checking the source run.

original_image.caption: 上半部列出记忆里的错误、超出适用范围及误用。下半部展示 Agent 沿链接回到原始记录，核查并改正经验。 原图作者为 Yukyeong Lee 等人（CC BY 4.0）。

articles.title: RSI-Env: An Open-Ended Environment for Recursive Self-Improvement of Agents

draft.overview: 用一次连续两轮的改进，观察新版本提升了什么，又失去了什么。
draft.reason: 一次实验中，Agent 连续改进自己两轮，事实问答更准了，科学推理却退步了。事实问答正确率从 82% 升到 85%，再到 88%，科学推理正确率则从最初的 65.2% 降到最终的 53.0%。

blocks.body:
第一轮，Agent 只改了模型周围调用工具、执行任务的程序，模型参数没动。第二轮，这个新版本自己写出 48 条训练样本，再用它们训练模型。
作者在固定的 500 道 SimpleQA 事实题上评估，每题做三次取平均，才得到 82%、85%、88% 这三个数。

第一轮改出来的版本亲自完成了第二轮，这才让我们看见自我改进如何延续。两次进步之后，下一代还能找出管用的改动吗？
另一个值得看的数字是它在其他科目丢了多少分。科学推理的回落提醒我们，看自我改进演示时，要同时看目标任务和原先就会的任务。
blocks.evidence: Knowledge Self falls to 53.0% on GPQA Diamond

localization.reason_en: In one run, an agent improved its own factual question answering over two rounds while losing ground on science reasoning. Factual accuracy rose from 82% to 85% to 88%, while science reasoning accuracy fell from 65.2% at the start to 53.0% at the end.
localization.summary_en:
The first update changed the harness, the software that runs the agent, leaving model weights fixed. That updated system wrote 48 training examples and trained the next model.
The authors evaluated all three versions on the same 500 SimpleQA questions. Each accuracy is the average over three attempts per question.
localization.thinking_en:
The handoff is what makes this run recursive: the first update helped produce the next. Two questions remain for sustained improvement. Can later generations keep making useful changes?
How much ability survives elsewhere? The decline on GPQA Diamond, the science reasoning test, shows why a target score alone gives an incomplete picture.
localization.image_title_en: Original figure 1 · How the updated agent takes over
localization.image_caption_en: The current system on the right contains a model and an editable harness. The lower loop carries an accepted version into the next round. The host on the left manages evaluation and versions.
localization.image_alt_en: A controller, controlled interfaces and a working environment are connected by an accepted-update loop.
